description: Unique sequential integer identifier assigned to each zoning district feature across all municipalities.

Name of town, city or incorporated village per the VT Geographic Area Names and Codes Standard.
Unique identifier of the town, city, or incorporated village per the VT Geographic Area Names and Codes Standard. Currently the Census GEOID; VCGI plans a combined town/village code (TVGEOID).
Full zoning district name as defined in the municipal zoning bylaw.
Abbreviated district name as used in maps and tables.
Classification of the district by its primary land use character (e.g., Primarily Residential, Nonresidential, Mixed with Residential, Overlay).
Date of the zoning bylaw document from which data was collected.

Vermont six-digit FIPS place code identifying the municipality within the state.
Identifier used in the source GIS system, typically combining municipality name and district name.
Date the record was last updated in the source dataset.
Perimeter length of the zoning district polygon in decimal degrees.
Area of the zoning district polygon in decimal degrees squared.
